name: Search shows empty state when nothing is published
description: Verifies the storefront loads with branding and browsing an empty catalog shows an empty state.
steps: Open the home page and confirm the SuperNulled logo is visible
Click Browse Resources in the navigation
Type 'plugin' in the title search box and press Enter
expected: The Browse Resources heading is visible and the message No resources found is shown.

name: Registration rejects a short password
description: Verifies the register form shows a Google option and blocks weak passwords before contacting the server.
steps: Click Register in the navigation
Confirm a Continue with Google button is visible
Enter test@example.com as the email and short as the password
Click the Create your account button
expected: The message Password must be at least 8 characters. is visible and no verification notice appears.

name: Anonymous visitors cannot use admin or library pages
description: Verifies anonymous users are denied admin access, redirected from private pages, and see a 404 for unknown routes.
steps: Open the address ending in #/admin
Open the address ending in #/library
Open the address ending in #/does-not-exist
expected: Admin shows Sign in required, library redirects to the Log in form, and the unknown route shows Page not found.

name: Administrator can configure Cloudflare Turnstile protection
description: Verifies the administrator can access the Turnstile configuration fields and see whether the server-side secret has been configured.
setup: Sign in using the configured site administrator account.
steps: Open #/admin
Select Settings
Find the Cloudflare Turnstile login protection section
Confirm the Site Key field, Secret Key status, and enable checkbox are visible
expected: The Turnstile setup section explains that the Site Key is stored in settings and the Secret Key must be configured server-side as TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.

name: VIP receipt screening and isolated test mode
covers: two free downloads per Manila calendar day
description: Verifies free download enforcement and the VIP payment review workflow, including suspicious receipt flags and a safe test mode that cannot grant membership.
setup: Sign in as an administrator, enable test mode but leave real payments disabled, then sign in as a Basic Member.
steps: Open a free resource and download it
Download a second free resource
Try a third free resource on the same Manila calendar day
Open Account and submit a test reference with a JPG/PNG/WEBP/PDF test receipt
Confirm the account shows a TEST-labelled pending submission
As an administrator, open VIP Payments and inspect the submission and any risk flags
Approve the test submission
expected: The third free download is rejected by the server; the test receipt appears as TEST; admin review can approve its workflow status but does not grant VIP access.
